sampled_loss.exclusions: All real items in the sampled user's training history only
sampled_loss.normalization: (beta*softplus(-positive)+sum softplus(negative))/(K+1), then mean targets/example and examples/branch
sampled_loss.calibration_claim: History-dependent K/N weighting heuristic; full-catalog calibration is unestablished

prefix_dropout.trace_format: Per update: row-major B/2 x ceil(MAXLEN/8) uint8 bytes, np.packbits along positions with bitorder=little; trailing bits are zero; terminal rows retain sampled batch order.

coefficient_exposure_definition: Sum of branch loss coefficients over completed optimizer updates; LR-weighted sums use the unchanged constant learning rate. These quantities do not imply equal gradients or Adam trajectories.
checkpoint_selection: strict HR@10 improvement; earliest epoch wins ties
checkpoint_eligibility: configured validation cadence and final epoch
comparison_status: Single sampled-loss arm with inherited schedule and prefix dropout. Run BERT4REC_LOSS_ARM=bce separately for matched K=16 ordinary BCE. No gBCE advantage is established without independent host evaluation of both arms; historical BPR scores are not a matched control. Architecture, candidate scoring and canonical predictor writer are unchanged.
